findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_fare · Private data: best_time_to_ride, list_cities, check_fleet_file · Public sink: check_fare · Destructive: get_airport, check_fleet_file.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_fare · Private data: best_time_to_ride, list_cities, check_fleet_file · Public sink: check_fare · Destructive: get_airport, check_fleet_file

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
